name: What is involved in a typical website optimization process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a typical website optimization process?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical website optimization process begins with a comprehensive audit of your current website to identify strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities. This includes technical SEO analysis, keyword research, content review, and competitor analysis. Next, a tailored strategy is developed, outlining specific improvements for on-page SEO, off-page SEO, site speed, mobile responsiveness, and user experience. Implementation follows, involving technical adjustments, content creation/revision, and ongoing monitoring. The final stage involves continuous tracking of performance metrics, data analysis, and iterative adjustments to ensure sustained improvement and adaptation to search engine algorithm changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an audit, strategy development, implementation of technical and content changes, and ongoing monitoring and adjustments.
